# Accounts

Fetch account information such as Projects version status.

```php
Teamleader::accounts()
```

| | |
|---|---|
| Class | `McoreServices\TeamleaderSDK\Resources\Other\Accounts` |
| Create / update / delete | — / — / — |
| Pagination | No |

## Endpoints

- `accounts.projects-v2-status`

## Filters

`list()` takes no filters.

## Examples

Check which Projects version the account is using:

```php
$status = Teamleader::accounts()->projectsV2Status();
                $version = $status["data"]["status"]; // "projects-v2" or "legacy"
```

Check if account will be automatically switched to Projects v2:

```php
$status = Teamleader::accounts()->projectsV2Status();

            if (isset($status["data"]["will_be_automatically_switched_on"])) {
                $switchDate = $status["data"]["will_be_automatically_switched_on"];
                echo "Account will be switched on: {$switchDate}";
            }
```

Check if account is using Projects v2:

```php
$isV2 = Teamleader::accounts()->isUsingProjectsV2();

            if ($isV2) {
                // Use Projects v2 endpoints
            } else {
                // Use legacy project endpoints
            }
```

Use different logic based on Projects version:

```php
$accounts = Teamleader::accounts();

            if ($accounts->isUsingProjectsV2()) {
                $projects = Teamleader::projects()->list();
            } else {
                // Handle legacy projects
                $projects = Teamleader::legacyProjects()->list();
            }
```
